main_text.p: facculos, arena, fale, alumine, sulphure plenos, vel oleum lilij, anethi, vel pulverem seminis anisi, baccarum lauri, et similium: vel ex his & stercore caprino, aut vaccino à vacca adhuc calido cataplasma: vel vnguentum agrippæ, vel limaces cum testa tritos cataplasmatis modo, donec per se cadant, admonere.Gal. lib. 11 simpli. Postremò ventris incisione aquas emittere licet, vbi cætera nihil profuerunt, si æger est iuuenis & robustus: nec tamen vniuersim vacues, sed particulatim per dies aliquot.

Aperitur autem ad musculum obliquum ascendentem dextrum, si hepar primario est affectum: sinistrum verò si lien cute prius deorsum reuulsa, vt post incisionem locum naturalem repetens, hiatum obturet, ne aqua largior effluat, vel immisso siphone in hiatu: aqua autem quotidie bis, aut ter siphonis operculo ablato mittatur, ægro interim roborato cibis delectis, & condituris analepticis: vt dialaccæ drachmis duabus mane sumptis: vel diacucurma, cum aqua intybi, absinthij, cassuthæ, & cibis calidis modicè humidis, tenuibus.

page.notes: Margin note at left reads "Gal. lib. 11" with "simpli" below, partly faded; transcribed as printed as far as legible. Ornamental ampersand forms rendered as &.
